Recipe: Paella valenciana
instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a wide pan and brown the chicken and rabbit on every side. This is not a five-minute job: it takes a good quarter of an hour, and there is no point rushing it — the flavour of the whole dish is laid down here. [Source step duration: 15 min]
2. Push the meat to the edges, put the green beans in the middle and fry them for a couple of minutes. Add the grated tomato and the paprika and cook until the tomato darkens and stops smelling raw. [Source step duration: 6 min]
3. Pour in the stock, add the rosemary, saffron and white beans, salt it noticeably harder than feels right and let it boil for ten minutes. This is the last moment you can correct the seasoning. [Source step duration: 10 min]
4. Scatter the rice in an even layer and level it once with a spoon. After that do not touch the pan again — no stirring, no smoothing.
5. Cook on a high flame for ten minutes, then drop to medium for another eight, until the stock is gone. The rice should be showing above the surface. [Source step duration: 18 min]
6. Turn the heat up for half a minute and listen: the moment the sound turns from bubbling to a dry crackle, take it off. That is the socarrat. Cover with a cloth and let it stand for five minutes. [Source step duration: 6 min]
